_comment: prepare_calibration.py: ~1M tokens (512 x 2048) of web / code / math. The first 128 sequences are set aside (not used by the study, but they fix which sequences are evaluated); the other 384 are the evaluation part for KL / perplexity (the study uses the first 32 of them). Mixture: FineWeb-Edu (sample-10BT, field 'text', 0.5), codeparrot-clean (field 'content', 0.25), open-web-math (field 'text', 0.25), train splits, documents in their stored order. Nothing is downloaded: edit the paths below to LOCAL copies (a parquet file or a directory of *.parquet, a .jsonl file, or a .txt file per source; decompress .json.gz shards to .jsonl first). Relative paths are resolved from the working directory.
